title: combine
description: A station at a fixed position on the shopfloor that realises one service. Each of its Actions runs one recipe: it produces the recipe's output product at the station's own position, but only while every input product of that recipe already lies at the station. The Actions themselves differ per station and are given in the instance Thing Descriptions.

produceBattery.title: produce battery
produceBattery.description: Run the battery recipe: consume batterycell and place battery at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.
